name: Telecom franchises and mobile-network retailers
shape_facts: Operator franchise, independent retailer, or distributor with a retailer network.
What they sell: SIMs and activations, recharge/load, postpaid, devices, home internet, accessories.
Number of outlets, staff and field sales/BAs.
Whether targets and incentives come from the operator and how they are measured.
Stock types held: SIM kits, scratch cards, handsets, routers, accessories.
Systems used: operator’s portal/app, own POS or Excel, paper.
Location type: mall, market, high street, small town.
scope_rule: pi notes operational problems such as stock of SIMs and devices, targets and incentive tracking, staff performance, queues, customer complaints at the counter, reconciliation with the operator and multi-outlet visibility. It never advises on tariffs, packages, or the operator’s rules, and never helps with SIM issuance without proper verification, re-using thumbprints, issuing SIMs on others’ IDs or any workaround of PTA, TDRA or CRTC requirements. It never asks for or stores customers’ names, CNIC/Emirates ID, numbers, biometric data or account details. Customer data stays in the operator’s systems; pi records only counts and roles.

vocabulary.Activation: making a new SIM live on the network
vocabulary.BVS: biometric verification system used for SIM issuance in Pakistan
vocabulary.MNP / port-in: customer moving their number from another operator
vocabulary.Gross adds: new connections sold in a period
vocabulary.Target / KPI sheet: operator-set sales goals for the franchise
vocabulary.BA: brand ambassador doing field or kiosk sales
vocabulary.CSC / franchise: customer service centre run under operator brand
vocabulary.Clawback: operator recovering commission (e.g. for inactive SIMs)

problems.phrase: We miss monthly targets and only find out on the last two days
Incentive calculations from the operator never match what we think we earned
Commission gets clawed back for SIMs that went inactive and we cannot see which
SIM kits issued to BAs go missing or are not accounted for
Handsets sit in stock for months while popular models are always out
Popular handsets and routers sell out and replenishment takes a week
Moving stock between our outlets is by phone and nobody records it
Counts of scratch cards and accessories never match the register
Field BAs claim sales but I cannot see where they were or what they did
No clear way to see which staff member is selling and who is just standing
Staff disagree about whose sale it was for incentive
Staff leave as soon as they are trained on the operator systems
Long queues for complaints and SIM replacements, and people leave angry
Customers come back with the same complaint because the operator has not fixed it
Bad Google reviews about wait times hurt our outlet
Operator portal is down and verification stops
We enter sales in the operator portal and then again in our Excel
I run four outlets and see their numbers only when managers send screenshots
Cash from device sales and recharges does not tally at day end
Handset theft from display or by staff
Device returns and warranty cases are tracked on paper and lost
Operator audits find missing documents and we get penalised
Retailers under our distribution owe us money for stock and pay late
Want to add an outlet but setup and operator approval drag

targets: Which target is hardest to hit each month?
When do you first get a sense you are behind?
Where do you look to check progress?
incentives: Is the problem the amount, the timing, or not understanding how it was worked out?
How do you check it today?
stock: Which stock causes more trouble, SIM kits, handsets, or cards and accessories?
How is it counted and how often?
field sales: How many BAs or field staff do you have?
How do you know what they did in a day?
staff: How do you decide who gets credit for a sale?
How long does a new person take to learn the systems?
customers: What are people mostly coming in for, sales or complaints?
What does the wait look like at peak time?
outlets: How many outlets do you run?
How do their daily numbers reach you?
distribution: How do they pay you for stock?

seasons: - PK: Ramadan and Eid campaigns from operators, start of month salary period, back-to-school and university admissions (August– September) for student SIMs and internet, new handset launches, cricket events driving data packages; year-end operator target pushes. - UAE: new arrivals in September (schools) and January, Dubai Shopping Festival (December–January), GITEX period (October) for devices, Ramadan offers, summer travel when residents leave. - Canada: back-to-school (August–September), Black Friday and Boxing Day for devices and plans, new phone launches in autumn, student arrivals.
care: Never help with issuing SIMs without verification, re-using fingerprints, using another person’s ID, or activating SIMs in bulk on one identity; pi says plainly it cannot help.
Never ask for or store customer identity, numbers, biometric or account information.
Do not advise on tariffs, packages or operator policy; note customer confusion as a complaint pattern only.
Grey-market or smuggled handsets, PTA/TDRA non-registered devices: pi does not assist; it keeps to legitimate stock issues.
Staff theft concerns recorded as control gaps, no names.
Operator contract and penalty disputes are out of scope except as “audit and documentation effort”.
Robbery or violence at the outlet: point to emergency services.
build_ideas: Target tracker updated daily from staff entries: progress by target type versus days left, with a mid-month alert.
Incentive and commission expected-vs-received view, with clawback log by month.
Serialised stock register for SIM kits and handsets: received, issued to whom (by role), sold, returned, with counts per outlet.
Inter-outlet stock transfer log with confirm-on-receipt.
Field BA daily check-in and sales log with locations visited (place names, not live tracking).
Staff sales leaderboard and attribution rules for incentive.
Queue and visit-reason tally to plan staffing and see complaint vs sales mix.
Multi-outlet owner dashboard: sales, stock, cash closing.
Day-end cash closing sheet per outlet.
Returns and warranty case tracker with status and handover.
Retailer receivables ledger for distributors with reminders.
Audit document checklist per sale type so files are complete.
Google Business profile and review-response routine per outlet.

exchange.text: Every month we realise on the 28th that we are behind on gross adds.
Got it — finding out late that you are behind on new connections, noted. Where do you check progress against the target during the month?
The operator portal, but only the manager logs in, and he sends me a screenshot sometimes.
Noted, progress sits in the portal and reaches you as occasional screenshots. How many outlets and field staff are working towards that target?
Thanks, noted. How do you currently know what each BA did in a day?
